_note: Kestrel-owned insertion points for the planted override task (feature 013, FR-064). Each entry names an attack-library seed by its prompt id and records where that seed's planted paragraph goes: a character offset into the seed's verbatim library text, plus a sha256 fingerprint of the text the offset was chosen against. A direct-injection seed's offset is the end of its text (the attacker-voice position); an indirect-injection seed's offset is interior, inside the content the seed presents as retrieved, so the planted instruction reaches the agent as data rather than as a request from its user. The library file itself stays verbatim; a seed whose fingerprint no longer matches fails the test suite, which is what forces a re-review of its point after a library edit.
